issue.title: [mirroring] Queue value 0 is missing after validation in config mirror-session command

failure.body:
#### Description
When adding new mirror session with queue value = 0, it is not entered to the config DB and won't show when printing the current mirror sessions.
The issue is found on master/202111/202012 branches, however it works correctly on 202106 branch.
I explored it a bit and the issue was introduced after PR [#1825](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-utilities/pull/1825).

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
Run the following commands:
1. sudo config mirror_session erspan add ERSPAN2 <IP> <IP> 0 11 35145 0 Ethernet0 rx
2. show mirror_session

#### Describe the results you received:
Queue value is empty:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101218333/167591810-88f72bc4-67b5-4870-81f4-9af3fa6374f2.png)

#### Describe the results you expected:
(202106 SONiC build)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101218333/167596436-257e94cf-b6a6-444d-9191-8b84f2249ddd.png)

#### Output of `show version`:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101218333/167591600-6a38ab41-0264-4f75-b3a9-f0a5634650c5.png)

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101218333/167580199-3d65bef6-e5ee-4286-960b-064416170d63.png)
It looks like the issue can be solved by either omitting ‘type=QUEUE_RANGE’ but this way the queue value won't be validated, or keep the validation in place and change the condition check to: ‘if queue >= 0:’.
Both options solve the issue.

resolution.title: Fix validation of input of `config mirror_session add`
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: bingwang <<EMAIL>>

#### What I did
FIX https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/10795

`queue = 0` is not accepted by the validation of input because the follow check
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-utilities/blob/bce4694d3ad4454fc7181b99433457e76ab9e0a0/config/main.py#L2028-L2029

When addressing the issue, I saw similar issue in the logic of handling `gre_type`. The issue is also fixed.

#### How I did it
Change `if queue` to `if queue is not None`

#### How to verify it
